'''Zero's lair''' was the headquarters of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Zero (droid)|Zero]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. It was located in the [[Network Security District]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR:ZP" />
